description:
Extend emit_slot_calls to detect register_event_handler calls inside for comprehensions in the linear body and wrap the entire loop in one memo_at slot.

## Mechanism

After hoist_comprehension_handlers, register_event_handler calls are already in the for-loop body in linear scope. emit_slot_calls detects for loops containing register_event_handler sites and wraps the whole loop:

  Before:
    for {value, label} <- filters do
      freh_N = register_event_handler(fn -> set_current.(value) end)
      {nil, %{...}, fn ... -> ... end}
    end

  After:
    memo_at({:t, 0}, [filters, on_change], fn ->
      for {value, label} <- filters do
        event_at(auto_idx, fn -> set_current.(value) end)
      end
    end)

## Dep analysis

Deps for the comprehension memo are the reactive variables that the handler fns inside the loop reference. Same compute_closure_deps logic already used by wrap_in_use_memo.

## Stability guarantee

If filters and on_change are stable: the whole handler list is reused, no register_event_handler calls, no hook slot writes. If either changes: all handlers recomputed. One {:t, N} slot regardless of list length.

## Acceptance

- Filter bar survives observable_update re-renders with no GenServer crash
- Clicking Active/Completed filters after adding a todo does not crash
- Adding a second todo (triggering store update) re-renders correctly with stable filter handlers when filters prop unchanged
title: flm-o58.3: Compiler — wrap comprehension for-loops in memo_at (whole-loop memoization)
